source_caption:
🎬 Home Alone 2: Lost in New York (1992)

Home Alone 2: Lost in New York follows Kevin McCallister, a clever young boy who accidentally boards the wrong plane while traveling with his family for Christmas. Instead of arriving in Florida, Kevin finds himself alone in New York City with his father’s credit card and the freedom to explore the city. Enjoying luxurious hotel stays, toy stores, and exciting adventures, Kevin’s holiday takes an unexpected turn when he encounters Harry and Marv, the same burglars who tried to rob his home the previous Christmas. Determined to stop their latest criminal plans, Kevin creates another series of hilarious traps while discovering the importance of kindness, friendship, and family. Starring Macaulay Culkin, Joe Pesci, and Daniel Stern, the film delivers unforgettable holiday comedy, heartwarming moments, and Christmas adventures.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Family • Adventure

⭐ IMDb: 6.9/10

⏱️ Runtime: 2h • PG

🎥 Director: Chris Columbus

✍️ Writer: John Hughes

📺 Where to Watch: Disney+ in the United States. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: Home Alone 2: Lost in New York is a 1992 American Christmas comedy film directed by Chris Columbus and written and produced by John Hughes. The sequel to Home Alone (1990) and the second installment in the Home Alone franchise, the film stars Macaulay Culkin, Joe Pesci, Daniel Stern, John Heard, Tim Curry, Brenda Fricker and Catherine O'Hara. The story follows Kevin McCallister as he is separated from his family on their flight to Miami, Florida and ends up in New York City. While initially enjoying his newfound experiences, Kevin soon encounters the Wet Bandits again after their escape from prison.
